business_model: A retail crypto trading app and wallet for Indian users, with fiat on-ramp through a payment partner. Growing user base from referral campaigns.

claims.text: A retail crypto trading app and wallet for Indian users, with fiat on-ramp through a payment partner. Growing user base from referral campaigns.

Risks recorded by the fund: Regulatory and tax uncertainty on crypto in India. Banking and payment-partner dependency. Trading revenue is cyclical. Intense competition from large, well-funded exchanges.

Partner assessment of founders from the meeting: Siddharth Menon, previously a growth lead at a payments company, and a co-founder with a blockchain engineering background. Capable and fast-moving; the user growth was real. In the meeting he spoke confidently about regulation, but his answers amounted to a bet that the rules would become friendlier. There was no plan for the scenario in which they did not.
